_comment: Mutation-scores browser-owned code only: Rust worker transport, OPFS persistence, result projection, and the UI graph projection. Preprocessing mutations belong to cargo-mutants because Rust/WASM is the only preprocessing engine. Run make mutation-web, measure the new set, then ratchet these provisional thresholds.
_ignoreStatic_comment: Retained from the measured runner limitation: module-load constants execute before Stryker activates a mutant and otherwise create false survivors.
_thresholds_comment: The former 96.22% score described the deleted TypeScript preprocessing engine and is invalid for this new browser-only mutation set. Thresholds stay non-claiming until a fresh complete run is recorded.
